body_en: Not every clever student looks famous at school. Some learn slowly, then jump ahead. Ask for help early. Teach a friend what you just learned. Keep trying after small mistakes. Your best idea may come after many common days.
body_zh: 并非每位聪明学生在学校都显眼。有人学得慢，然后突然跃进。尽早求助。把刚学会的教给朋友。小错误后继续试。你最好的想法可能出现在许多平常日子之后。
